$comment: Copy into the project, fill in, and keep out of version control if it carries credentials.
Point the database connection at a restored copy of a backup, not at production.

database.$comment: Use socketPath for a local restore, or host/port for a remote read replica.
database.name: wordpress_restore

$comment: cdnBase is the delivery origin for offloaded media.
offloadTable is REQUIRED whenever a media offload plugin is installed.
Without it, references resolve to paths that do not exist in object storage.

seo.$comment: Set to null if the source has no SEO plugin, or name the plugin's table.

redirects.$comment: Legacy 404-redirect plugin table, if one exists. Set to null otherwise.
